mapper.select: SELECT r.rno,r.uno,p.pno,p.name as pname,r.r_content,r.r_img,r.r_score,u.profile_img,TO_CHAR(r.r_created_at,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') as dbday FROM review r JOIN users u ON r.uno=u.uno JOIN place p ON r.pno=p.pno WHERE r.uno=#{uno} ORDER BY r.rno DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
